description: Record or resolve one commitment such as a promise or agreement. The owner contact is auto-injected into participants if missing.

commitmentEventId.description: Commitment event id. Required when action=resolve.

affectsBond.description: Whether evidence affects the relationship; defaults false for like/follow/repost labels and observations with significance <=2; explicit true opts in.

channel.description: Free-text channel, trimmed and lowercased, at most 40 characters.

content.description: Verbatim text, including empty text; at most 1 MB UTF-8. Summary may be omitted when content is supplied.

dueAt.description: Optional due timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

now.description: Optional timestamp override. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

occurredAt.description: When the commitment was made, Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

participants.description: Participant list. Must be non-empty and include the owner contact.

contactId.description: Participant contact id. The owner contact MUST be included.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

occurredAt.description: Optional resolving event timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

resolution.description: How the commitment was resolved. Required when action=resolve.

name: manage_commitment
